40 Cult Songs from Germany: Artists like Jan Delay (Klar), Sportfreunde Stiller (54, 74, 90, 2010), and Söhne Mannheims (Und wenn ein Lied) are represented just as much as Die Höhner (Viva Colonia), Helge Schneider (Käsebrot), and Die Zillertaler Schürzenjäger (Sierra Madre). This ensures the game covers the entire spectrum of German music and is equally interesting for players young and old.

Sing, dance, and have fun together: Lips: Deutsche Partyknaller is far more than "just" a karaoke game. On one hand, many songs are accompanied by their original music videos; on the other, the two motion-sensitive wireless microphones (sold separately for this version) ensure that Xbox 360 singers have to deliver a sizzling live performance to get the high score. Keiichi Yano, the Japanese developer who has already programmed several highly successful music games, was able to bring all his ideas to life with "Lips."

Lips: Deutsche Partyknaller is far more than just a karaoke game and is available as a standalone version as well as in a bundle with 2 motion-sensitive wireless mics.

Your Avatar joins the game: Lips: Deutsche Partyknaller allows for the integration of Xbox LIVE Avatars, which boosts the fun factor. Furthermore, this game is one of the first titles to allow players to unlock exclusive accessories for their Avatars.

467216.overview: Experience a fresh new puzzle game, easy to pick up but fiendishly difficult at high level play. Participate in the Internet Rankings at edngames.com and prove you are the best!

468431.overview: Hippies and treehuggers stay out! Enjoy our beutiful nature like real men do - with a shotgun! Put yourself to the ultimate lumberjack challenge, to find and cut down the 1000year old magic oak. This is a top view, classic style shooter for one or two players. Join the epic fight of man against nature, now!.. Oh, and watch out for Rambi, he is pissed off since you killed his mom.

476230.overview: Ladybird Galaxy is a fixed-screen arcade game. The player controls a space ship which collects gems in order to achieve a high score. A combo multiplier starts after collecting stars which allows to earn even more points. It runs out after some time, but this can be prevented by collecting more stars. Ladybirds which move over the screen but don't actively chase the player cause the loss of a life when touched. This is made more difficult by the big turning arc of the ship. Revenge is only possible after collecting special stars which allow the space ship to briefly shoot. Occasionally laser beams appear which have to be dodged by utilizing the fact that the ship appears on the opposite site after leaving the screen. After enough points are earned, the difficulty level rises and the game ends after all lives are gone.

476231.overview:
Lair of the Evildoer is a top-down shooter set in a closed environment that consists of 20 floors. The player has to descend and clear the floors off enemies to reach Dr. Odious who locked up the character in his lair. It is primarily an action game but also contains a number of RPG elements.

The character can be moved around and aim in any direction. Enemies can be destroyed using melee attacks or long-ranged weapons. Only two ranged weapons can be carried at any time. Guns need to be reloaded and have a limited amount of ammo. When a new weapon is discovered, the statistics can be compared to decide whether to swap or not. Ranged weapons are defined through damage, force, firing speed, damage per second, spread, clip size, ammo consumption and reload time.

By destroying opponents the character gains experience and can level up. Points can be assigned to dexterity (primary damage, sidearm damage, and accuracy), strength (melee damage and max ammo), vitality (max XP and regeneration rate), and defense (defense and mass). Enemies have health bars and often appear in large numbers. Pick-ups include weapons, ammo, and health. The levels are procedurally generated and that way they are different for each playthrough. The game contains 30 enemy types and 25 weapons with additional variations.

476233.overview: Explore a mystic labyrinth filled with strange and sexy creatures.

476234.overview:
Step into the strange world of the Labyrinth as Amelia, a young woman with no memories of who she is, or why she is trapped here. All she knows is that she must travel deeper, towards the tall Black Tower.

She will learn that even darker secrets await her in the deeper layers of the Labyrinth. She wants to escape and regain her memories, but the Labyrinth is more than just a maze.

476235.overview:
You are a worthless rabbit. However you have the privilege of helping further science. What lies before you are a series of experiments. They will test you speed, your agility and the effects of high powered lasers on rabbits.

Why you may ask? SCIENCE!

476236.overview: Hordes of delicious but evil coconut and chocolate covered treats are trying to take over the world! Grab your guns and fight back! Or you can team up with a friend and fight together!

476237.overview: Landmark is a concentration variant. The player is confronted with a number of tiles concealed tiles. During each turn, two of them are chosen and revealed. If they have the same picture, they stay open - otherwise they become concealed again. The goal is to open up all tiles. The game features four difficulty modes which differ in number of tiles (six or nine pairs) and rotation (the playfield either does not rotate, rotates after each wrong guess, rotates after every turn or rotates continuously).

476238.overview: Welcome to Lander Mania, an exciting single or multi-player game, where each player racks up points by landing their ship safely. Rotate your ship and fire your thrusters to get the perfect speed and angle or you will crash! Battle your friends for the top of the scoreboard, by bashing into them and getting to the landing pads first!

476239.overview:
Try to collect as many money bags as you can, while avoiding baddies. Up to 3 friends can join you to help you collect more money and find the exit to win!

A very addicting and fun game, which is randomly generated, so you will never play the same game twice!

476240.overview:
Use the lasers to zap the different colored orbs, but be careful not to zap yourself!

Try to complete all of the challenges as you rave on.

476250.overview: LaserBreaker is a fun game in which you have to destroy a target employing laser shots of four different colours. In each stage the target is protected by some blocks, which only can be destroyed by laser of its own colour.

476251.overview: You have one cannonball left. The enemy is too far away to hit.... but don't fret. Bounce the ball off of landmines and fallen foes to get more distance. Watch out for birds and sand traps though. Go the distance and get the high score. Play with up to 4 players on one controller.

476253.overview:
Bennetor is attacked by forces from the neighbouring, and so far allied, kingdom Variste. After protecting his/her home, the player character sets out to find out Variste's motivations for the attack. Soon it becomes clear that the whole balance of power of the region hinges on finding one last fortune...

The Last Fortune is a side-scrolling action game with platforming elements. While walking from point A to B (usually left to right), the player jumps over gaps and other obstacles and primarily fights various enemies. Besides swinging the melee weapon up close, the only other available option is using the character's active special attack. However, this requires energy which is refilled by picking up lightning symbols during the levels. Between levels the player character visits a shop and can spend coins (earned by slaying enemies) for additional health, extra lives or more abilities like a double jump or other special attacks. Getting hit by enemies deducts live energy and eventually leads to death and the need to restart from the last checkpoint. When all lives are gone, the player needs to restart the whole level or purchase a continue.

When starting a new game, the player has the choice between two characters: Andre and Jeanne. They do not only have different special attacks, but also have their own dialogue during the frequent story sequences. Those consist of animations in the game engine and speech bubbles of the speaking characters. There are three difficulty levels and an optional arcade mode which does away with the story.

476255.overview: A test of deduction and perseverance: engineer the grid's clues to leave no section devoid of laser beams. Once you've become a master of the board, challenge your friends in VERSUS mode, or challenge yourself with an endless supply of generated puzzles.

476256.overview:
LaserCat returns home one day to find that his owl friend Owlfriend has been kidnapped by the evil magic space frog Wizzord. Wizzord demands one million British Pounds Sterling of LaserCat for the release of Owlfriend, to be paid in full before tea time...but LaserCat doesn't have one million British Pounds Sterling! Thus, he decides he must take matters into his own hands, venturing into Wizzord's castle to rescue Owlfriend himself.

LaserCat is a multi-screen exploration-based platform game comparable to Jet Set Willy or VVVVVV. Exploring the castle, which contains 225 rooms total, the eponymous LaserCat must collect the 30 keys hidden throughout in order to open the gate to Owlfriend's cage. When collected, keys send LaserCat to the Riddle Realm, where they are presented with a trivia question -- answer correctly, and he can keep the key, but answer wrong and he is dropped in a pit of lava. Checkpoints are generously placed around the castle, and can also be warped between for easy travel. Death sends the player back to the last checkpoint reach, and returns and keys carried to their original location, but carries no other penalties.

476257.overview:
Become a Dragon and face up to three of your friends in an epic battle!

Conquer the realm and become the Dragon God. Breathe fireballs at your opponents to destroy their Eggs. Destroy Villages to gain Powerups and buy upgrades to keep evolving your Dragon.

Can you be the Last Dragon Standing?

476268.overview: Fight your way through waves of ships in this 3D arcade style space shooter! Use your laser blasters and specialized weapons called "Pods" to destroy your enemies. The Pods' effects range from giving your ship a speed boost to creating a gravity well to suck in your enemies. Rack up the points in Survival or play through Arcade mode where you'll fight your way through to face the capital ships!

476269.overview:
You are the Zombie Hunter. You are ready to make your Last Stand against the zombie horde.

You are trapped in a small bunker with zombies digging their way up through the ground. With each zombie that you kill, they grow even stronger.

Purchase stronger weapons to help you to last as you can. Get power ups to give you an advantage against the zombies for a short time.

476275.overview: Even when the undead strike, someone's gotta do the lawn!! Mow the lawn before the zombies get you in this fun, yet heart-pounding, revisit of a Commodore 64 classic! Start your lawnmowers!

476276.overview: I can't feel my legs... [ This games contains Coarse Language. Player Discretion is Advised ]

476277.overview:
Lazy Caverns is an arcade platform game. If you like retro game(Manic Miner,Jet Set willy..) You like this Game.

Features:
-Over 25 Levels
-Online High Score
-Retro graphics

476278.overview: Lazy Caverns 2 is a platform game. Guide Robby's father again to collect all marbles on each level.

476279.overview: A first person dungeon crawling adventure in the style of early 80s LCD gaming. Explore seven levels of monsters, treasure and teleportation traps to reclaim the crown of kings. No watch batteries required!

476280.overview:
Return to the monochrome dungeon in a newer, bigger adventure.

Gain XP and level up, find different weapons, face wandering monsters and save high scores.

476283.overview:
Let your child learn their ABC's and 123's while having fun watching things come to life on the screen, with the clouds bringing rain, flowers attracting butterflies and the sun, the airplane and the windmill in motion. Finish off each session with fireworks.

Catchy background music and some random sounds should keep your kid entertained for a long time.

Learning something was never so much fun!

476285.overview: This game teaches you Math and Science.

476286.overview:
Teach your children, significant other, or grandparents how to use the Xbox controller with this fun game for learning the buttons!

Make art and music in freestyle mode, test out those budding skills by showing the space hamster how fast you are getting, or test your memory by copying robot dance moves!

Learn the Controller features unique levels, different audio styles, and plenty of fun.

476287.overview: Transform your TV into a LED Display!

476288.overview: The Emperor Wharg III has invaded the galaxy. Survivors of all the resistances of all planets are joined under the command of the great commander, Lucente. Lucente has created a rebellion force named the league of planets, an army to fight and take back all the planets of the Galaxy.

476289.overview: Learn Basic Italian is a simple tool to learn Italian. This app have different categories like Basic Phrases, Vocabulary and Grammar.

476290.overview: Free Language Tutorials: Basic Phrases, Vocabulary and Grammar in 4 Languages.

476291.overview:
The Legend of Aylesbury is a 2 player co-operative platformer where a couple must rescue their pet duck using their unique abilities.

One player can turn into a bird, the other can use their grapple hook and together they can perform co-operative actions to span the landscape.

476292.overview: Learn Basic French is a simple tool to learn French. This app have different categories like Basic Phrases, Vocabulary and Grammar.

476293.overview: This game has teaches you the presidents of United States, learn the first lady, 50 States and etc.

476294.overview: All you have to do is get the food in your mouth. Simple.

476295.overview: Abstract shooter with dynamic difficulty and metaphorical explosions. Fixed length game session. Score points. Increase difficulty. Split shots. Leave Home...

476308.overview:
Legend of Max is an arcade adventure game. Help Max (little DOG) to find his master.

In this game, you must find key, make puzzles, combinations to advance..

476309.overview: Long ago, in the Age of Runic Magia... Fantastic creatures roamed the land and Runes, the source of all magic, were available to all. That was until the Rune Lords came to hoard all of the precious Runes. Particularly the ancient and powerful Runic Magia. Legend of the Rune Lords: The Quest for Runic Magia is a short-form RPG featuring classic console RPG gameplay.

476310.overview: An epic old school platform adventure in which Lemmy battles the Mecha-Eggs with his toxic spit, ninja kick and inventory full of consumable treats. Under the guidance of his Uncle Lenny he must venture across grassy plains and explore underground caverns to grab the buglets and save the egglets on his way to his ultimate challenge: the Citadel!

476312.overview:
Cool shooter. Fight, collect money, upgrade weapons. Unleash hell on enemies...

Enjoy.

476317.overview: Let's Learn Japanese: Beginner is a language learning game that helps to teach the Japanese written language. Learn Hiragana, Katakana, Kanji, and common words using Flashcard, Quiz, and Review mode.

476318.overview: In a world that gives you lemons, make lemonade... and SELL IT! Aided by break-even analysis and weather forecasts, determine the most profitable strategy by deciding stock levels, price, and marketing. Monitor sales throughout the day and track growth with daily graphs and reports. Simple to learn but difficult to master, you must compete for top place in the company league table!

476319.overview:
Have you ever wanted to learn Japanese? Are you studying Japanese and want to improve your skills? Then Let's Learn Japanese: Deluxe is for you! Designed for beginners and those learning Japanese, you will learn about the language basics, the 3 character sets, common words, and pronunciation.

Learn Hiragana and Katakana, Kanji, and 1700+ common words using Quiz, Flashcard, and Review mode. It also includes spoken pronunciation and stroke order!

476320.overview: A young accountant is on his way to meet with a client, when something unexpected happens causing maximum surprise.

476322.overview: Welcome back into the battle of Proetynia! This new episode of Lethal Judgment will let you fight against aliens all along the original levels of previous games. Play 5 furious stages with HD graphics and win 15 challenges to unlock all the included awards.

476323.overview:
LEUCISTIC WYVERN is a deep-scrolling shooter. Control your character, the Wyvern, and shoot down waves of approaching enemies!

There are nine stages in total. Stages 3 and 6 are bonus stages.

476324.overview:
You never thought going into space was a good idea... Turns out you were right.

See how long you can survive in this simple and fun-to-play shooter.

476325.overview:
Can you beat the clock? Can you beat the challenges?! Are you 1337 enough to SPELL?!

I don't think you are. Move along...

476326.overview:
Build a city using just your words in this innovative puzzle-strategy game where each part of speech has a different effect!

Citizens will flock to your city, but can you keep them happy and safe from harm?

Test your skill through 4 varied worlds in a challenging 10+ hour campaign.

476327.overview: Play the popular series of PC Shoot them up on your Xbox 360 with a specially updated HD version of the game. Fight along 5 infested levels of Aliens and try to survive.

476328.overview: Draw pictures and send them to friends and family over Xbox LIVE.

476329.overview: Frantic fun for the whole family as you try to eat as many bugs as you can with your lizard using child friendly controls, but beware of the bees!

476330.overview:
Rescue drowning victims from the beach, and stuff. 21 levels, half of them runner, the other half a mix of CPR, driving, swimming, and flying.

Does anyone ever read these descriptions? I doubt it... If you're one of the 0.001% of people still reading, send me a tweet on twitter saying you read til the end and I'll send you a free download code (if I still have any).

476331.overview: Munch. Spell. Score. How large is your vocabulary? Capture the falling letters to create words. Use double and triple-score tiles and chain multiple bonuses to keep time from expiring and get the high score.

476332.overview: Take on your friends in this 1 - 4 player fight to the death! Combining elements of many of your old, favourite classics into a single, modern, SUPERGAME OF TOTAL CHAOS AND DESTRUCTION!!

476333.overview: Catch the lights falling from the sky to light up your lamp! Get special color combos to get more points and go for the high score. Play cooperatively with a friend or duke it out to get the most points.

476334.overview: Shooting game with an artillery barrage. Modern people came to be able to use necromancy by the power of OOPARTS "Lewjmele" that ancient civilization invented. However, evils that conspire to dominate the world begin to abuse the power as it happened in remote ages, which involves destiny of three nations and three heroes.

476335.overview: Crafted in the spirit of classic adventure games, Life in the Dorms also brings some modernity to the genre by introducing a new, social media-inspired feature. After Dack collects the smart phone item, he'll be able to "Flitter" to his followers about his environment, the people around him, and even things in his inventoryâ€”in fact, he'll have to, in order to solve many of the game's challenging puzzles.

476336.overview: Draw pictures on your own or together with friends over Xbox LIVE. The pencil, brush, bucket and many colors to choose from helps you create the picture you want.

476337.overview:
Lifeless, an experimental and personal interpretation about loneliness.

Decipher its mysteries and discover its 4 possible endings.

476338.overview:
Join the elite combat team known as the Light Fighters in a variety of battle modes.

Compete Head-To-Head in Multiplayer or try to save the Colony from impending doom. Prove your skills and valor by entering the Galactic Tournament where you will face the toughest foes in the Galaxy.

Utilize special abilities to gain the upper hand in battle or relax to the interstellar tunes of the Galaxy Radio.

476339.overview: Where does one man end and another begin? Become any character you meet in this unique story-driven game! Unforgettable characters, engrossing story, and 20 original songs make Light's End a must-play experience.

476342.overview:
In "A Light Start" you take control of your own crawler and must collect energy for your queen crawler, so that she can remove the darkness and light the world.

Dig your way through the world and avoid the dangers of the dark. "A Light Start" features procedurally generated levels and a level editor to allow you to create and play your own levels.

476396.overview: LightFish is a highly addictive arcade game, where the user controls a small fish who lives in the abyssal deeps of the ocean... surrounded by deadly creatures. His objective is to destroy all the monsters who inhabit those dangerous zones by drawing lines onto unexplored territory. However, any enemy who manages to touch the Lightfish will kill him instantly!

476555.overview: Lodestar, the robot that will steal your heart and crush your mind makes his debut in Lodestar 1000. The challenge starts off with classic Simon gameplay, but takes a detour across the DPad and Thumbsticks. Can you handle it? If not, bring your friends because this Simon game has CO-OP! Made awesome by 8-bit graphics, C64 sound FX and an original chiptune soundtrack that builds dynamically!

476556.overview:
In a world populated by ninjas, you must slice your way through waves of invading ninja puppets.

Team up with your friends or ninjas controlled by artificial intelligence and let the battle begin!

476557.overview: Milkstone Studios presents the ultimate 2D arcade racing game, now with online multiplayer! Master your driving skills and defeat your opponents with style on one of the more than 20 tracks available. With new improvements based on user feedback, and much easier handling, the game includes quick race, custom race and championship mode, and also the new online mode for up to 12 players.

476558.overview: Solve over 750 levels across three difficulties in this mind bending puzzle game. Try the new Time Attack mode to see how many puzzles you can solve before time runs out.

476559.overview:
Featuring all of your favourite Youtube stars, this is the first and only game that lets you truly Like, Favourite or Shoot them!

With global leaderboards and HD graphics, this is your chance to gun with the stars!

476560.overview: Can you run through the maze of the light and shadow, and can you reach the exit safely? Easy, simple action maze game.

476561.overview: Kill the demons, absorb their blood for powerups! Lil' Demons: Splatter includes Wave Survival and King of the Hill game modes, piles of weapons, and supports multiple 3D rendering modes including anaglyph glasses. All for just 80 points!

476562.overview:
Dive into a spectacular stereoscopic gaming experience.

Steer you spaceship in full 6 degrees of freedom through 30 stunning levels. Complete a level by eliminating the floating rings, pierce through their middle to make them disappear. But beware! Time is limited and numerous obstacles and monster try to hinder or even destroy you.
br This game supports side by side and anaglyph stereo video modes.

476563.overview: Staged in a classical puzzle style, link attack infuses an original puzzle concept with impactful imagery influenced by former Soviet Union communist propaganda. Original audio arranged and recorded in-house provides an invigorating background to the constant action. As a puzzle game, Link Attack contains 6 different game modes that task the player with unique and individual challenges. This constant excitement is further elaborated through interaction with the players Xbox avatar which is present and very much active throughout gameplay. A competitive two player mode finishes off the roster with a fast paced and invigorating mode and full high score tables round off the competitive spirit of the game.

476564.overview:
Zap through moon rock with the Z-50 laser canon and blast through steel floors with the X-3 space drill!

Cross vast distances using alien transporters and bridge gaps with the power of thought!!

Just some of the tools required to guide the Little Green Men (LGM) to safety over Martian landscapes and extra-terrestrial obstacles.br
Make life and death decisions sacrificing a few to save the many.

476566.overview:
If you love to slaughter endless waves of zombies, then this is the game for you!

It includes 2 game modes, unlock-able weapons, high scores, and more!

476567.overview:
How long can you last flapping your wings while avoiding the spinning blades of death.

Scoreboards and local multiplayer keeps you coming back for just one more go.

476568.overview: Little Kingdom is a simulation game. You're the leader of a small kingdom aiming to conquer the world. In this peaceful world without war or battle. Strengthen your economy and dominate the world with your influence. Choose your map, choose your teammate, and choose the AI levels! Little Kingdom is playable up to 4 players on the same screen. (without splitscreen)

476569.overview:
You’re the leader of a small kingdom aiming to conquer the world. In this peaceful world without war or battle. Strengthen your economy and dominate the world with your influence.

Contains a map generator.

It's the enhanced version, more buildings, more resources, new graphism, a new HUD, new gameplay options, more enemies , bigger map...

476570.overview:
Milkstone Studios presents the next installment in the indie racing series, now with online for 12 players! Drive the 30+ high speed cars on a 3D,weather-changing city! Career mode provides hours of fun, challenging races. You need to tune your car and earn money to get the most wanted cars.Pursuit the top ranks and become the best in the world! Underground racing has never been so fun!

Little Racers STREET is a much needed refresh to the top-down racing genre! Offering a whole 3D city with lots of different tracks and enviromental effects, the game's key point is its career mode.

You'll have to start from scratch, with a low class car. Win races and complete challenges to earn credits, and spend them upgrading your car or purchasing new ones. Featuring 30 different cars, challenging opponents and varied race conditions, this game offers hours of fun and enjoyment!

476572.overview:
In a far off, dystopian world, there are two kinds of humans: the Unlimited who possess free will and the limited who do not.

KANA is a young, limited girl who one day has broken away from her servitude programming and has stolen a rocket pack. She sets off to kill the Empress.

476573.overview: Guide Mr. Nibbles the acorn hoarding squirrel through a variety of levels in this charming platforming adventure. Collect the acorns scattered around each zone to stock up for winter. Featuring super simple controls, a variety of game mechanics with a cute and lovable look, Little Acorns is an adventure that is completely at home on iOS.• LITTLE ACORNS...BIG GAMELittle Acorns features 60 cleverly designed levels to explore! Spread out over 4 seasons and 3 years, you'll be hunting nuts for hours on end!• SEASONED GAMEPLAYFluid, simple platforming controls that mean players of all skills can enjoy this captivating adventure. With classic platformer gameplay, mixed with a modern visual style, you'd be nuts not to love it.• SQUIRREL POWER!Collect power-ups to save time and grab high scores including a time stopping clock and an invulnerability crash helmet. Dodge or defeat a variety of enemies including dopey caterpillars and hanging spiders on your way to collecting all the acorns and fruit in the game!

476575.overview: Little Monsters have started appearing everywhere, and now they're starting to run riot. You must carefully place your bombs to blast them! This Physics puzzler will provide you with a fun challenge. 6 different types of Monster, ranging from the cute little Fuzzle, to the obnoxious Bloater. A range of other obstacles such as exploding barrels and melting ice will certainly to keep you busy.

476576.overview:
Study the level. Turn off the light. Walk to the goal.

LightsOut is a unique game where you must solve each level using sound, timing and memory. You have 99 seconds to pass the level which is ideal if you have a few minutes before dinner, or even "just one more level" before you go to bed.

There are 10 exciting ways to play. 
Can you pass all 100 levels?

476577.overview: Play as Lady Strategy, a young lady heir of a dying country. A 4x for everybody: Explore the world, expand your empire, extract the resources and exterminate the enemies. Contain : a campaign, a map generator, a map editor, real time and turn base, 4 players.

476582.overview: Race against ninjas, pirates, robots and zombies! Unlock more than 10 different runners and 5 different tracks in campaign mode. Race against or with your friends in relays, three-Legged races and more!

476583.overview: Let's be honest, RPG's are more fun with machine guns. Experience fast paced action supported by loot collection and item optimization. Drop in multiplayer means you never have to wait in lobbies. Plunder the universe with friends to take on tougher foes; then PvP to see who has the best gear!

476584.overview:
Loot Grinder is an RPG inspired by the 16-bit era classics. It is all about doing battle and unlocking new classes and abilities.

Customize your team at anytime by assigning job classes that you have unlocked. These jobs give new abilities as you level up.

Travel to a destination long enough to unlock special Boss battles. If your heroes are strong enough to win, they will be rewarded.

476585.overview: The game has a creative area with powerful voxel editor tools. You can join friends online and build together.

476586.overview:
Logan's Treasure is an arcade platform game.

Guide Logan to collect all 40 Keys on each levels, and go to open the treasure Chest.

476587.overview: In 1993 a group of Satanic Estate Agents bought up property in key areas of the world to act as a demonic staging area and gateway to the depths of hell, summoning forth unspeakable evil. LOL LOL Kitty, a weaponized house cat and government black project is deployed by the US Military in order to take out the trash.

476588.overview:
This is a side-scrolling action game. This game has 12 Levels. You must find the key which can open the door to exit.

You can stamp monsters, get your coins. If 100 coin is collected, it is exchangeable for a treasure box.

If it clears once, difficult stage composition can be played.

476589.overview:
Plunder the universe in a never ending quest for better loot and harder challenges. Engage entire worlds with up to four other players.

Prestige mode lets you play forever as your enemies scale with your progress.

476590.overview: This frantic party game pits 2-4 pirates against eachother in a mad race for gold! Use all your cunning and prowess to become top dog!

476591.overview: Jump in to a party-style adventure game, bash down monsters within a minute, grab some loot and save the day! Lootfest is an action adventure game, in 3rd or 1st person view. Random generated voxel world with a fantasy setting. Up to four players, drop in, split screen co-op.

476592.overview: A top-down view space shooter that is easy to pick up and play, yet rewards mastery of subtle tactics. Detailed 3D graphics and fast-paced combat are combined with a ten mission story-driven campaign. Online co-op and skirmish modes add great replay value.

476593.overview: Enjoy a block building fest with your friends. Make stunning structures in no time with the game's easy to use creation tools. Fight off zombie hordes with your trusty sword. Race your friends using the RC cars. You can do anything you want, as long as it's blocky! (Update1: RC Helicopter, air plane and pirate ship. Blocks with letters. File backup and restore. Animated block creations tool) (Update2: Create animated objects, make your own pets and doors. Tools to quickly build geometric shapes)

476594.overview: A game of skill, accuracy and guts! Pilot your ship from moon to moon while avoiding the asteroids. Score points by landing on moons and clearing the limitless levels. Your only offense is your deft maneuvering, while your defense is the shields you earn by scoring points.

476595.overview: Lootfest is back for everyone who loves classic adventure games. With more monsters, weapons, missions and of course - more loot! Explore a large world with your friends, using an easy drop-in multiplayer. Any combination of split screen and online gameplay is supported.

476596.overview:
This is a game you can enjoy golf and gambling machine with. Decide an angle and power to put a ball in a cup. Winnings increase as you place the right bets. Maybe the farther the cup, the better the chance.

1 player: Increase your winnings. kinds of the gambling machines be increased when you increase maximum winnings.

2-4 players: Compete with other player in scores.

476597.overview: Save Great Britain from the biggest threat it has faced since the Beatles broke up! Fight aliens alone or cooperatively in this very British puzzle shooter. Kill lots of aliens to unlock power ups and extra play modes, including a jolly good fun level editor. Also includes realistic British weather, with a 1 in 4 chance that it will be raining whenever you play!

476599.overview:
Are you hardcore enough? Climb your way as high as you can in this platforming shooter complete with an insane collection of guns and explosives.

Lots of Guns will have you fighting zombies under an evil moon, out of control robots in a factory, medieval knights, and monster slime creatures on your journey.

Voxel styled pixel art gives this game a distinct but retro feel.

476600.overview: Love Hurts is a side scrolling beat em up about mans redundant need to save princesses and the fact that cliches are cliches because they work.

476602.overview:
The year is 3016 and Pandas are now the dominant species of planet Earth. Amongst this God-like species exists one Panda in particular, known simply as Mr Panda, who left his home planet in search of adventure.

In this revolutionary new video game you take full control of Mr Panda as he negotiates gravity, uneven surfaces and a finite amount of jetpack fuel!

477765.overview: Lumi, the 2010 DreamBuildPlay winner is an action/puzzle/platform game, in a marvelous 2D universe. You control Lumi, a small creature with powers based on magnetism and light, and with the goal to save the universe sunk into darkness.

479779.overview:
William was smart, handsome and wealthy; he never once questioned his success or place in the world. After a one-night stand, he is forced to face the truth about himself.

Did he earn what he had or was it just luck?

In this beautiful "point and click" style game, you will solve puzzles and discover secrets about yourself and your family's fortunes.
